title: Innovation Incubator | Center for Teaching & Learning
text: Innovation Incubator Innovation Incubator With a goal to infuse our educational efforts with technology to achieve an active, experiential, and research-based approach to learning, the CTL Innovation Incubator (formerly ASSETT) engages collaborative teams of faculty, students, and staff in cycles of design thinking to develop innovative ideas for teaching and learning with technology. Funded teams work in three year innovation periods supported by the CTL innovation catalyst and other team members. Our Mission The mission of the CTL Innovation Incubator is to improve the undergraduate experience by making learning more active, accessible, and inclusive. Our Values Experimentation: Calculated risk-taking leads to unexpected discoveries that can generate new knowledge and new ways of doing things. Failure: Valuable insights are gained and exciting new directions taken when things “don’t work." Emergence: New ideas need time to develop — oftentimes unexpectedly through both undetectable evolution and surprising bursts. Our Vision We envision a diverse community of learners — composed of students, faculty, and staff — who are engaged in purposeful, collaborative, creative, and impactful learning experiences. Our Campus Partners We are proud and grateful to partner with units across our campus that lend their resources, expertise, and people to make the ASSETT Innovation Incubator a robust and successful program! title: Project Based Learning Studio | Idea Forge
text: Project Based Learning Studio Previous Next Project Based Learning Studio Previous Next The Project Based Learning Studio, on the ground level of the Idea Forge, is a classroom completely dedicated to learning through hands-on experience. With its round tables, the room holds classes that focus on teamwork and small group discussion rather than lecture. There are many dry-erase boards on wheels to use for break out sessions, general group work, or dividing the room into multiple sections. Location: MBE 33 Seats: 60 Questions? Contact Jenny Brown Available Equipment: - computers - mobile tables & chairs - mobile whiteboards - projector - sound system Access: First priority in the classroom is given to scheduled courses. Outside of scheduled courses, the classroom is open for use by anyone. Contact Jenny to schedule for an event Associated Fees: - no fees for general use - reservation fees for large scheduled events may apply, contact Victoria Lanaghan for details
